cells.gaps: No progress report against the policy's own actions has been found, and no body is named as mandated. A research report dated 2025-10-08 (GHA-001) still calls the policy not final, but it rests on 2022 survey data and is dated only by publication, so it does not outweigh two 2024 rows saying approved and adopted. A successor, the National Digital Transformation and Emerging Technology Strategy, was only begun in April 2025 (GHA-010) and is not adopted. Stage 4 needs reporting published within three years, and the cap needs a mandated body and a domestic budget line.
cells.note: Instrument: Ghana Digital Economy Policy and Strategy (2024, target timeline 2028). Adopted, text public and inside its period, but no reporting has been found, so not stage 4.
